name: chip
title: Chip
description: Label chip. Static, a toggle filter, or removable.

keyboard: Toggles a filter chip or activates the remove button
Static chips are skipped; toggles and remove buttons are stops
aria: Tones use a tint background and text of at least 4.5:1
a11y.notes: A tone (success, danger) is never the only signal: put the meaning in the text. Pressed chips change fill and border (a 2px Highlight border in forced colours); aria-pressed carries the state. A protocol chip always writes the protocol as text.
